'''Josip Pečarić''' (born 2 September 1948) is a Croatian mathematician and writer. He is a professor of mathematics in the Faculty of Textile Technology at the [[University of Zagreb]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.math.pmf.unizg.hr/en/josip-pe%C4%8Dari%C4%87|title=Josip Pečarić|department=Department of Mathematics|publisher=University of Zagreb|access-date=10 June 2020|archive-date=11 June 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200611065244/https://www.math.pmf.unizg.hr/en/josip-pe%C4%8Dari%C4%87|url-status=dead}}</ref> Croatia, and is a full member of the [[Croatian Academy of Sciences and Arts]].<ref name="hazu" /> He has written and co-authored over 1,200 mathematical publications. He has also published a number of works on history and politics that have been described as comprising [[historical negationism]] or [[Holocaust denial]].

==Education==
Pečarić was born in [[Kotor]], [[Montenegro]] (at the time part of [[Yugoslavia]]) on 2 September 1948,<ref name="hazu"/><ref name=homepage>{{cite web|title=Personal page|publisher=University of Zagreb|website=Faculty of Textile Technology|url=http://www.ttf.unizg.hr/index.php?str=53&osoba=15&lang=en}}</ref> where he remained to attend elementary and high school.<ref name=Moslehian /> He studied at the [[University of Belgrade]]'s [[University of Belgrade Faculty of Electrical Engineering|Faculty of Electrical Engineering]] for his undergraduate and master's degrees, which he completed respectively in 1972 and 1975.<ref name=homepage /> The supervisor of his master's degree, mathematics professor, Dobrilo Tošić, inspired him to switch fields to mathematics.<ref name=Moslehian />

Pečarić remained at the University of Belgrade, working on his PhD in mathematics from 1975 to 1982.<ref>{{cite web |title=Josip Pečarić :: Detalji znanstvenika |url=http://tkojetko.irb.hr/znanstvenikDetalji.php?sifznan=4227&podaci=izobrazba |website=tkojetko.irb.hr |access-date=8 March 2011 |archive-date=18 March 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120318165915/http://tkojetko.irb.hr/znanstvenikDetalji.php?sifznan=4227&podaci=izobrazba |url-status=dead }}</ref> He received it under the supervision of Petar Vasić.  His dissertation was on ''Jensen's and related inequalities''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=154275|name=Josip Pečarić}}</ref> He began working at the University of Zagreb in 1987.<ref name=homepage />

==Mathematics career==
Pečarić is known for his work in the theory of [[Inequality (mathematics)|inequalities]].<ref name=Moslehian>{{cite journal|url=http://www.emis.de/journals/BJMA/tex_v2_n2_a17.pdf|title=An interview with Josip E. Pečarić|last=Moslehian|first=Mohammad Sal|journal=Banach Journal of Mathematical Analysis|volume=2|number=2|date=2008|pages=163–170|doi=10.15352/bjma/1240336302|doi-access=free}}</ref> He has founded several journals, all published by Element in Zagreb: he is currently Editor-in-Chief at ''Mathematical Inequalities and Applications''<ref>{{cite web |title=Editorial board |url=http://mia.ele-math.com/editorial |website=Mathematical Inequalities & Applications|publisher=Element |access-date=9 February 2020 |location=Zagreb}}</ref> and at the ''Journal of Mathematical Inequalities'',<ref>{{cite web |title=Editorial board |url=http://jmi.ele-math.com/editorial |website=Journal of Mathematical Inequalities|publisher=Element |access-date=11 February 2020 |location=Zagreb}}</ref> and also founded ''Operators and Matrices''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Editorial board |url=http://oam.ele-math.com/editorial |website=Operators and Matrices |publisher=Element |access-date=11 February 2020 |location=Zagreb}}</ref>

Pečarić has written and co-authored over 1,200 articles on mathematics in journals, books, and conference proceedings.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/search/author.html?mrauthid=137335 |title=Josip Pečarić author profile|website=[[MathSciNet]]|publisher=American Mathematical Society|url-access=subscription}}</ref> He has also coauthored over 20 mathematical books, including 6 that are written in English.

==Political views and historical negationism==
<!-- Pečarić's political writings have been a matter of disagreement on the talk page for this article.  Please gain consensus there before making any substantial changes to this section -->
In addition to his mathematical work, Pečarić has published more than 20 books and 40 articles on history and politics.<ref name=Moslehian /> This work is from a far-right point of view, and has been criticized as comprising [[historical negationism]] or [[Holocaust denial]].<ref name=N1Wiesenthal>{{cite news|url=http://hr.n1info.com/English/NEWS/a361178/Simon-Wiesenthal-Centre-urges-Croatia-to-ban-Jasenovac-revisionist-works.html|title=Simon Wiesenthal Centre urges Croatia to ban Jasenovac revisionist works|work=N1 Zagreb|date=9 January 2019|access-date=15 February 2020|archive-date=9 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201009060853/http://hr.n1info.com/English/NEWS/a361178/Simon-Wiesenthal-Centre-urges-Croatia-to-ban-Jasenovac-revisionist-works.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

For example, Pečarić has advocated for the return of the World War II-era fascist salute ''[[Za dom spremni]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://balkaninsight.com/2016/06/20/defending-hooliganism-does-croatia-no-favours-06-20-2016/|title=Defending Hooliganism Does Croatia No Favours|last=Nielsen|first=Christian Axboe|date=20 June 2016|access-date=15 February 2020|work=Balkan Insight}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.jutarnji.hr/vijesti/hrvatska/akademik-koji-zagovara-za-dom-spremni-vrstan-matematicar-s-doktoratom-iz-beograda-i-amaterski-povjesnicar-ridikuloznih-stavova/294055/|title=Akademik Koji Zagovara 'Za Dom Spremni'|language=hr|trans-title=The Academic Advocating 'For Home Ready'|last=Rudež|first=Tanja|date=27 August 2015|access-date=15 February 2020}}</ref> This salute has been called the Croatian equivalent of the German ''[[Sieg Heil]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vecernji.hr/vijesti/ustaski-za-dom-spremni-je-ekvivalent-nacistickom-sieg-heil-904408|title= Pozdrav 'Za dom spremni' ekvivalent je nacističkom 'Sieg Heil!'|language=hr|trans-title='For Home Ready' is the Equivalent of the Nazi 'Sieg Heil!'|last=Kristović|first=Ivan|work=[[Večernji list]]| date=22 November 2013|access-date=15 February 2020}}</ref> His 2017 book ''General Praljak'' reinvents the [[war criminal]] [[Slobodan Praljak]] as a humanist and war hero.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lakic |first1=Mladen |last2=Vladisavljevic |first2=Anja |last3=Rudic |first3=Filip |title=State of Denial: The Books Rewriting the Bosnian War |url=https://balkaninsight.com/2018/10/19/state-of-denial-the-books-rewriting-the-bosnian-war-10-18-2018/ |website=Balkan Insight |date=19 October 2018}}</ref> His books ''Serbian Myths about Jasenovac'' and ''The Jasenovac Lie Revealed'', the latter coauthored with [[Stjepan Razum]], argued that the [[Jasenovac concentration camp]] was a labor camp with much lower casualties than the commonly accepted figure, and that the bulk of its victims were Croats killed by Yugoslav communist authorities after the war.<ref name="Cohen">{{cite book |last1=Cohen |first1=Susan Sarah |title=Antisemitism: An Annotated Bibliography Volume 17 |date=2013 |publisher=Walter de Gruyter |isbn=978-3-11095-694-8 |page=238 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=PYIjAAAAQBAJ&pg=PA238}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Vladisavljevic |first1=Anja |title=Book Event Questioning WWII Crimes Planned for Zagreb Church |url=https://balkaninsight.com/2019/01/07/new-revisionist-book-on-jasenovac-wwii-camp-01-07-2019-1/ |website=BalkanInsight |publisher=BIRN |date=7 January 2019}}</ref><ref name=N1Wiesenthal /> This last prompted the [[Simon Wiesenthal Centre]] to advocate the Croatian government to ban publications denying the war crimes of the [[Ustaša]].<ref name=N1Wiesenthal /><ref>{{cite web|url=https://balkaninsight.com/2019/01/09/wiesenthal-center-urges-croatian-authorities-to-prohibit-denial-of-ustasha-crimes-01-09-2019/|title=Croatia Urged to Prohibit Denial of Ustasa Crimes|website=Balkan Insight|last=Vladisavljevic|first=Anja|date=9 January 2019|access-date=15 February 2020}}</ref>

==Honors and awards==
Pečarić has received a number of honors and awards.  He was awarded the Croatian National Science Award in 1996,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mzo.gov.hr/istaknute-teme/drzavne-nagrade/drzavne-nagrade-za-znanost/dobitnici-drzavne-nagrade-za-znanost/drzavne-nagrade-za-znanost-za-1996-godinu/624|title= Državne nagrade za znanost za 1996. godinu | language=hr|trans-title=National Science Awards for 1996|publisher=Republic of Croatia|website=Ministry of Science and Education|access-date=5 February 2020}}</ref> and received the [[Order of Danica Hrvatska]] in 1999.<ref>{{cite web|website=Narodne Novine|date=27 May 1999|title=Odluka o odlikovanju Redom Danice hrvatske s likom Ruđera Boškovića|language=Croatian|url=https://narodne-novine.nn.hr/clanci/sluzbeni/1999_06_61_1107.html|access-date=30 January 2020}}</ref> Pečarić was appointed to [[List of members of the Croatian Academy of Sciences and Arts|full membership]] of the [[Croatian Academy of Sciences and Arts]] in 2000.<ref name="hazu">{{cite web | url=https://www.info.hazu.hr/en/clanovi/pecaric-josip/ | title=Josip Pečarić, F.C.A. | publisher=[[Croatian Academy of Sciences and Arts]] | access-date=18 December 2021}}</ref> In 2008, a conference was held in honor of his 60th birthday and an issue (volume 2 no. 2) of the [[Banach Journal of Mathematical Analysis]] was dedicated to him.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.emis.de/journals/BJMA/v2n2.htm|title=Volume 2 Number 2|work=Banach Journal of Mathematical Analysis|access-date=5 February 2020}}</ref> Another conference was held in 2014 in Pečarić's honor on the occasion of the publication of his 1000th mathematical paper.<ref>{{cite journal|title=A Thousand Papers of Josip Pečarić|journal=Journal of Mathematical Inequalities|volume=9|number=4|last=Varošanec|first=Sanja|pages=961–981}}</ref>

== Selected bibliography ==

=== Textbooks ===
*''Recent Advances in Geometric Inequalities'', co-authored with [[Dragoslav Mitrinović]] and Veno Volenec. Dordecht : Springer Science & Business Media (1989). {{ISBN|978-94-015-7842-4}}
* ''Inequalities Involving Functions and Their Integrals and Derivatives'', co-authored with Dragoslav Mitrinović and A.M. Fink. Dordecht : Springer; Kluwer Academic Publishers (1991). {{ISBN|978-94-011-3562-7}}
*''Convex Functions, Partial Orderings, and Statistical Applications'', co-authored with [[Frank Proschan]] and Y.L. Tong. Boston : Academic Press (1992). {{ISBN|9780080925226}}
*''Classical and New Inequalities in Analysis'', co-authored with Dragoslav Mitrinović and A.M. Fink. Dordecht : Springer Science & Business Media (1993). {{ISBN|978-94-017-1043-5}}
*''Mond-Pečarić Method in Operator Inequalities'', co-authored with Takayuki Furuta, Jadranka Mićić Hot and Yuki Seo. Zagreb : Element (2005). {{ISBN|9789531975711}}
*''Multiplicative Inequalities of Carlson Type and Interpolation'', co-authored with Leo Larsson, Lech Maligranda and [[Lars-Erik Persson]].  World Scientific Publishing Co. (2006). {{ISBN|978-981-4478-36-6}}

=== Journal articles ===
*''Inequalities for Differentiable Mappings with Application to Special Means and Quadrature Formulæ'', with [[Charles E. M. Pearce]] in ''Applied Mathematics Letters'' (2000). {{doi|10.1016/S0893-9659(99)00164-0}}
*''Hadamard-type Inequalities for S-convex Functions'', with Ugur S Kirmaci, Milica Klaričić Bakula and Mehmet Emin Özdemir in ''Applied Mathematics and Computation'' (2007). {{doi|10.1016/j.amc.2007.03.030}}
*''New Means of Cauchy's Type'', with Matloob Anwar in ''Journal of Inequalities and Applications'' (2008). {{doi|10.1155/2008/163202|doi-access=free}}

===Non-fiction books ===
*''Srpski mit o Jasenovcu: Skrivanje istine o beogradskim konc-logorima''. Zagreb : Croatian information centre (1998).
*''Srpski mit o Jasenovcu II: O Bulajićevoj ideologijigenocida hrvatskih autora''. Zagreb : Element (2000).
*''Serbian myth about Jasenovac''. Zagreb : Stih (2001). {{ISBN|9789536959006}}
*''Književnik [[Mile Budak]] sada i ovdje'' [''Writer Mile Budak here and now'']. Zagreb : Vlastita naklada (2005).  {{ISBN|9789539888747}}
*''General Praljak'', co-authored with Miroslav Međimorec. Zagreb : Vlastita naklada (2017). {{ISBN|9789537575212}}
*''Razotkrivena jasenovačka laž'' [''The Jasenovac Lie Revealed''], co-authored with [[Stjepan Razum]]. Zagreb : Društvo za istraživanje trostrukog logora Jasenovac (2018). {{ISBN|9789535856511}}
